headline: Brazil Faces Urgency on Budget Revisions to Avoid 1% GDP Deficit in 2027
summary: Brazil's government must review the federal budget, incorporate election promises, and define tax reform regulations to prevent a 2027 fiscal gap that the IFI warns could hit 1% of GDP.
why: Brazil's fiscal discipline and debt trajectory are key determinants of Brazilian sovereign risk premiums, domestic interest rates, and the value of the real.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Warnings of a potential fiscal deficit reaching 1% of GDP raise sovereign credit concerns and fiscal pressure.
